notes: The dummy subject and copula in “It is good” are constructionally licensed by טוֹב and are not additions.
The complementizer and modal auxiliary in “that … should be” belong to the finite English realization of הֱיוֹת.
The ASV phrase “meet for” is kept as a noncompositional correspondence with כְּנֶגֶד rather than treating “for” as added.
